name: codex-orchestrator
description: Tmux-aware sleep/continue orchestrator for Codex agents.

interface.shortDescription: Suspend and resume Codex agents through tmux-aware local orchestration.
interface.longDescription: Provides a Codex skill plus a local Python server that detects which tmux pane requested a timed sleep and resumes that pane automatically.
defaultPrompt: Use the orchestrator skill to schedule a delayed resume for this agent.
Start the orchestrator server and route /sleep back to the tmux pane that requested it.
Inspect the orchestrator plugin and explain how tmux auto-detection works.
